elements.element: Vendor shall maintain commercial general liability insurance with a limit of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: The redlined clause contains no commercial general liability insurance requirement or per-occurrence limit.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain commercial general liability insurance with an aggregate limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The redlined clause contains no commercial general liability insurance requirement or aggregate limit.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Licensor must maintain E&O insurance, but only at USD 1,000,000 rather than the preferred USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, Vendor shall maintain cyber/privacy liability insurance of at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: The clause requires cyber and privacy liability insurance of only USD 2,000,000. Thus, even if the condition applies, the required USD 5,000,000 limit is absent.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.
elements.evidence: The redlined clause contains no workers' compensation insurance requirement.

elements.element: Vendor shall provide certificates of insurance upon request.
elements.evidence: The redlined clause contains no obligation to provide certificates of insurance upon request.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section (l) requires Licensor to maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain cyber/privacy liability insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section (l) requires Licensor to maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

result.reason: The operative language fully implements the stated fallback E&O and cyber/privacy limits, but omits the preferred CGL, workers' compensation, and certificate requirements and uses lower E&O and cyber/privacy limits than preferred. The amendment is minimal because it adds only the two fallback insurance requirements and leaves the existing representation-by-counsel provision unchanged. However, drafting quality is low because the insurance clause does not specify the applicable limit basis, policy duration or claims-made continuity, and it uses “Licensor” rather than expressly confirming that Licensor is the Vendor.
